audit.whatIsWrong: Content level chart gave Ryze Level 1 and 'Skill' at Level 2 and Level 6, contradicting the packet levelChart (Garen for all six pre-item stages), the 56.94% Garen win rate over 2297 games, and the whys[] text which already says Garen wins Level 1.
audit.why: Garen is melee with a 300-range Q silence and no mana cost; Ryze at level 1 has only Overload (40 mana, 5s) and cannot disengage. He has no dash and Rune Prison is not learned. Lane difficulty is early-favoured Garen, flipping only once Ryze completes mana-stacking items.
audit.corrected: Garen wins Levels 1 through First item; Ryze takes over at two-plus items. Chart flipped as an atomic group in both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Garen's Levels 3-5 window (Courage online, W CD 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s), Level 6 Demacian Justice execute (120/100/80s), and Ryze's two-item mana-stack scaling. All four spike entries exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] called Rune Prison a 'point-blank root' on a 14s cooldown. Riot's text: Rune Prison is 615 range, cooldown 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, and it only ROOTS if Spell Flux is already on the target — otherwise it merely slows. The decisive interaction (Garen's Q silence cutting Ryze's Overload-reset chain) was never stated in the interaction field. focus.text and tldr carried the garbled auto-generated phrase 'Ryze flux wave clearance and instant rune prison roots'.
audit.why: Ryze's whole kit is a cast chain: Spell Flux (E, 3.5s down to 2.5s) applies Flux, every basic ability resets Overload, and Flux upgrades W from a slow to a root. Garen's Q silence denies ability casts outright, so a landed silence breaks the chain at its root and Ryze cannot even convert W into a root. Q also breaks all slows on cast, purging a non-Flux Rune Prison slow.
audit.corrected: State that Rune Prison roots only through Flux, give the real 9-11s cooldown and 615 range, and key the advice to Q-silence timing.

audit.why: Rune Prison at 11s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown and the text already keys commitment to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded that Garen's Q purges slows on cast, which answers a Flux-less Rune Prison.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'breaking free of all slows affecting him.' A Rune Prison cast without Flux applied is a slow, so Q removes it.
audit.corrected: Folded into the tldr and the Key Ability Interactions line.
